order: Add memory files to the Director's authoring exceptions in the guard hook: the project's memory file and its local sibling, user-level memory under the assistant's config directory, and any project path matching a new directorMemoryPatterns knob. Blocking memory writes breaks the built-in auto-memory that the Director alone maintains. Document it in the protocol and README, reusing the plan carve-out's containment discipline of resolved, traversal-checked paths inside the project or config directory. Fence the carve-out with a single rule — simulate each write, with Write, Edit and MultiEdit semantics, and deny the result unless the whole ORCHESTRA:BEGIN/ORCHESTRA:END block arrives byte-for-byte. Surviving marker lines are not by themselves sufficient evidence, since the text between them must come through intact too. Keep the new denial model-aware, and leave non-memory paths blocked exactly as today. Separately add harness versioning, with a VERSION file as the single source of truth, stamped by the installer into the protocol header and surfaced by /orchestra-status.
claims: The exception covers the project memory files, config-directory memory and directorMemoryPatterns matches, and every other path still falls to default law. The managed block rides through each permitted memory write byte-for-byte: the write is simulated and the result denied unless the block arrives whole, so surviving markers alone cannot buy an edit through. The denial is model-aware, and dormant sessions never see it. Version format holds at X.Y.Z, read from the VERSION file. Verified against the 22-case hook matrix plus an install, re-install and uninstall round-trip.
